// diagnostic E2716

Jet.GrammarNotation

This grammar's text does not read as rules

What

This grammar's text does not read as rules

Why

A grammar literal is rules in the form `name : alternatives ;`, read like ANTLR 4 notation, and this text breaks that form.

Fix

Write the rule as `name : alternatives ;`, each alternative a sequence of elements.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.GrammarNotation: Tests/UI/grammar_notation.stderr.

Error: Jet.GrammarNotation: Expected an element, `|`, `)` or `;`, found `:`
  --> Tests/UI/grammar_notation.jet:7:10
    |
  7 |     WORD : [a-z]+ ;
    |          ^
 Why: A grammar literal is rules in the form `name : alternatives ;`, read like ANTLR 4 notation, and this text breaks that form
 Fix: Check the rule against `name : alternatives ;`
